query:
SELECT
            rp.action            AS action,
            rp.repository_id     AS repository_id,
            cs.id                AS "selector_id?",
            cs.includes          AS "includes?",
            cs.excludes          AS "excludes?"
        FROM role r
        JOIN repository_privilege rp ON rp.role_id = r.id
        LEFT JOIN content_selector cs ON cs.id = rp.selector_id
        WHERE r.name = $1
